title: FIFA boss Gianni Infantino remains under fire for U.S. red-card shenanigans

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: FIFA boss Gianni Infantino remains under fire for U.S. red-card shenanigans
sources.description: FIFA president Gianni Infantino, who has been hopscotching around North America for most of the last month to attend as many World Cup matches as humanly possible (we've wondered at times whether he has a teleportation device and/or a body double), can't outrun the biggest controversy of the tournament.
